title: Never Stop Becoming
body:
Man... it’s taken a while for me to discover a name for my character, but I think I’ve finally settled on calling him Oath.

I feel like he’s a representation of me more than I’d like to admit. Looking back at the older art from when he was just getting started, when I was still figuring out what he would look like and slowly shaping his history around things I’ve been through, only pushes me further toward the name Oath.

He represents the part of me that keeps deciding things have to change, even when I do not entirely know how to make that change happen. A lot of the promises I have made to myself did not begin with a clear plan. They began with the recognition that I wanted something better, or that I could no longer remain the person I had been.

I have not always followed through perfectly, but I keep returning to those promises. Maybe that is what the name means to me. Not certainty, and not perfection, but the decision to keep trying to become someone better.

…Maybe the promise was never to become one specific person. Maybe it was simply to never stop becoming.

title: Yea... Me Neither.
body:
Not a very eventful day; It's only 6:00 PM, but I had a solid time at the gym and spent a good chunk of the day seemingly cleaning by spraying things down and mopping and keeping things organized. Now it's time to dig in and eat more throughout the day to keep that calorie and protein count up like the past couple of days... maybe spend some time learning French or more about web design.

Also got around to playing a bit more of Oath, it's still been pretty fun if not a bit sad and somber with the tones and moods it's playing on. Loss, confusion, what-ifs, etc... will try to complete more of it later in the evening now that I have some free time on my hands.

.......do you ever feel like it's too late? .....yea.... me neither.

title: Keeping My Oath
body:
Wrapped up the lil' Oath project late yesterday, think it turned out pretty nice actually. Was fun piecing this together in After Effects, making sure it looped properly, and then exporting a few different sizes to use as Discord banners and Steam artwork.

Need to try to wrap up the game itself later today or over the weekend when I have more time... feeling busy all the time feels productive, but so tiring at the same time. Better than sittin' around doing nothing all day I suppose.

title: Fricken' Birfday
body:
O hell yea, it's my fricken' birfday 🎉🎉🎉 Getting older with... I guess... a little to show for it?

Spending a good chunk of the day at the gym, followed by studying/reading up on some of the new ChatGPT/Codex updates that should be dropping today... also working on another small lil' video project as I learn more about After Effects.

I've been really big into 'oath' lately and want to recreate a scene/album-art with my character. Isolating and animating individual pieces of the project has been pretty fun, I'm sure it'll take me a day or so to get it where I want but I'm enjoying the process.

Also took some time in the evening to troubleshot the 'Playing...' part of the website. I was not expecting to teach myself about blob storage and cache poisoning tonight but... well... here we are.

I'm also brining Lyn-z back into the journal... it was a bit childish to redact her name but felt right in the moment to suppress memories I suppose. Future me will understand.

title: Getting Out There
body:
Another crazy chill and eventful day today... staying in contact with a few of the cute people I met on the 4th at Red, White, and Bass feels really good, especially when it comes to planning hangouts or more events in the future. I also took a random shot and met a few people that were looking for friends in the area and met up at a local brewery to grab some drinks and converse and we all hit it off really well, might be a solid little start to even more friendships.

When I decided to make the next few months about self-improvement and decided to tackle 'getting out there more' as my first goal, I honestly wasn't expecting it to go this well and for it to be a bit awkward, but it's really been natural for me and comforting knowing that I can be thrown to the wolves and still make friendships that should seemingly last into the future. Hard, hard. ✌✌

title: Don't break our oath...
body:
Took long enough to start doing this but I'm finally seeing some agressive and noticeable progress at the gym now that I'm eating WAY more and targeting much higher calorie intakes. I was making some super solid progress the past year or so, no doubt, I've changed a LOT from who I used to be and what I used to look like, but finally putting pen to paper and tracking what I'm eating, intakes, weight limits, etc has been really solid.

Also started playing vai5000's game, Oath, which has hit a lot of recent pain points that I wasn't expecting. Still a super solid lil' game and I'm enjoying it, over the years, I think vai5000 has become my favorite artist. All of her music is just crazy good and well made.

title: Red, White, and Bass
body: Red, White, and Bass was fucking insaneeeee. I'm so glad I pushed myself to go solo, it was a night full of memorable moments and memorable people, everyone is so fucking nice... perhaps even a little too nice at times, and everybody is just there to go crazy, dance, and forget their worries. I don't know if this is a new character arc for me, but this definitely woke something up in me. I was NOT planning on staying until 2:00am, but I'm glad I did.

title: Killing Floor 2
body: Nothing too crazy happened today, enjoyed a day off and met a few new friends to play Killing Floor 2 with. All good fun. Still feeling a lot better, it's nice to return to my old self without any of the drama that has been lingering.

title: A Fun Lil' Weekend
body: Pretty simple day today, nothing too crazy going on and I have a ton of videos to edit for work but I still want to get some entries into my journal. Looking forward to my birthday this month, as well as the little rave/concert on July 4th, honestly, should be a fun lil' weekend and I'm looking forward to now that I'm actually starting to feel like myself again.

title: Honest Work
body:
Feeling way better today, surprisingly. Slept well, woke up well, hit the gym well. Should have pushed that 300lb deadlift today, was just 5lbs off, might chase it next week sometime. Eating more is paying off, it seems. It ain't much, but it's honest work, especially considering where I came from all those years ago. 💪💪💪

Checked out the new Jackass Movie which was... alright... very nostalgic. Also made the trek down to Buc-ee's and it was... alright. Fucking massive, I don't know what the hype was about but was a fun adventure.

title: A Small Step
body:
I just want to feel like myself again. I don't know why that's so hard.

I think I struggle seeing people express desires, wants, and dreams... but then show no effort in trying to obtain said desires, wants, and dreams and instead assume that everything will fall into place if they wait long enough. If you want better, you gotta' go get it. Even a small step in that direction is a step that you hadn't taken previously and pushes you closer to the end goal.

title: The Energy to Fight On
body:
Another early entry for today, as I fear nothing too eventful will happen. Worked late getting my VRChat Avatar setup yesterday, I like learning new things like texturing and modeling. Even though I used a paid base as the... well... base... I still had fun learning how to edit textures and change pieces of the models and export/upload to the VRChat website. I think he came out pretty nice, especially with the Nomad Complex hoodie. :3

Going to head to the gym today and spend another day focusing on myself. I feel like I'm in a much better place mentally now, and I'm grateful for friends and even strangers taking the time to check on me... I know I'm a fucking yapper all the time, so when I'm quiet and visibly hurt I'm grateful that people offer support and help rather than judging me.

*"The reason anybody gets through any of this is because
There are people in our lives that care desperately about our wellbeing
And um, when you disappear, they don't yell at you
They come up to you and they say, "Are you okay?"
And that, that alone, just somebody that you know
Is thinking of you, and um, concerned about you
It gives you the-the energy to fight on"*

title: ADHD-Coded
body:
Finally feel like I got some decent sleep and feel better today... the battle with ADHD always feels like such a chore. I always seem hyper-fixated on whatever is in front of me, yet still find it hard to knock these tasks out. I honestly think that's why things like the gym have helped more than meds ever really have, it exposes me to tons of options and people so there's always something to jump around to when your attention wanes.

And then you have the duality of meds that help solve these problems, but the issue is that they don't really make you feel like yourself. I feel like my levels of ADHD make me... me... and the solutions make me feel a bit disconnected. Sometimes my brain hits a point where it's like... "*Fuck it, let's just go for it.*" and, well, we certainly went for it.

I'm starting to feel more like myself. Physical strength is no substitute for mental strength. I'm getting strong every day, but sometimes I need to take a step back and realize that it's ok to just vibe around and cry to let it out. Keeping things bottled up never helped anyone. Your body is sending you important signals, don't try to ignore that.

I think self realization makes me stronger in the end tho'... I've discovered a problem, the reason, and the solution and I'm doing my best to fix that with the information presented. :3

Also trying to teach myself how to adjust, create, and modify a VRChat avatar to make it look more like my character. We'll see how it goes, but it's pretty confusing. It is doing a good job keeping my mind off of everything else in the world.

Went out for a nice lil' aimless drive since it wasn't too hot today... which is surprising. I feel like it's such a great way to clear your mind, especially with a manual that requires more of your attention and keeps your mind from wandering too much. This car still brings such a dumb smile to my face when I drive it.

title: ...I miss you.
body:
4:01 AM... feeling better after a couple of drinks last night. We’ll see how I feel later in the morning once clarity hits. I’m going to focus on eating, the gym, and studying today.

I know it's too early for something new... but I feel like writing this gets it off my chest. Some mornings just hit heavier than others, especially when your head is full of things you wish you could have said better.

Early morning... earbuds in. Early morning air. Softcult on repeat. I'm going for a walk.

Later that night, 8:30 PM... just got done playing Content Warning with TJ and Cody, and it kinda reminded me how fun stupid games like that are.

...my head might still be spinning, but I know when to offer a sincere apology. Some friendships stay with you, even when they get quiet. ♥

title: Rabbit Hole
body:
Finally a day where nothing overly eventful happened... exhausted... but glad things are calming down. Jumped back into a bit of VRChat last night and ended up spending nearly 2 hours playing Cards Against Humanity with complete strangers, and it was a blast... pushed me to invest in an actual VR headset to start the rabbit hole, Meta Quest S3. We'll see how it goes and if it pushes me into another expensive rabbit hole hobby... it'll be nice to mess around with and finally play Half-Life: Alyx at the very least.

Good conversations and pump at the gym today. Maybe it's placebo, but I've really been working on eating more and I'm seeing a few small changes here and there... unless my lack of self preservation is pushing me to the limits.

Really big into "idgaf" by fauxx again.

title: Overstimulation
body:
Listening to a lot of DARKNET lately, and I really dig and vibe with their anti-social-media, anti-drug messaging while poking fun at concepts like modern day society having hilariously short attention spans. Modern life is so surrounded in overstimulation and being hollowed out.

I'm also starting to like ditching my phone lately, or throwing it into Zen Mode where I can't really use it until Zen Mode is over. The disconnect has always been important for me and something that seems to really annoy others. It's weird when people can't comprehend putting your phone away for hours at a time to just vibe with life.

Had another solid gym day, getting a lot better at a 225lb squat. Someone at the gym really helped push me for more reps and helped with form and everything. I probably have a higher PR in me, but I'm not willing to ego-lift myself to death yet. Still struggling with eating more though. I'll get it down at some point, but eating more is so expensive.

Lots of good little messages between friends today, even though some can feel really disconnected from time to time. Probably one of the biggest reasons I'm so anti-narcotic.

Old habits fade slower than I'd like sometimes. I'm too old to keep running in circles, but at least I can tell I'm moving in a better direction. -_-

title: Clearing Clouds
body:
Today started off a bit somber, slower paced, even a bit sad. Followed by an insane session at the gym, and I feel like I'm starting to feel like myself again. I'm grateful to people at the gym that help me see perspectives otherwise clouded by the fact that I overthink e v e r y t h i n g. I feel like the clouds in my brain are slowly clearing as I drop back to reality and realize what I want in life.

Now it's time to force myself to eat more chicken and rice to stabilize that caloric intake. Today made me feel stronger both physically and mentally.

Song I love right now: "idgaf" by DARKNET. The whole thing has that blunt little mental reset energy, especially the "I pledge not to care" part.

I also finally took the plunge and came across an artist I like that had an open slot for a headshot commission, @Fanayaart. It was a bit pricey all things considered, but I need to start supporting real artists and getting real art done of my character. AI is useful for creating and bringing an idea to life in the moment, but I think I've started to crave actual art the way I've always craved real music. In a world where everyone can create their own music, art, and movies using AI, there's an even stronger need and desire for real artists.

title: Showing Up For Future Me
body:
Today had a few small but memorable moments. The morning started with a really good drive into work, cruising most of the way next to a girl in a white STi that sounded great. It reminded me how much I still want to upgrade to an STi someday. The EJ sound just has such a distinct character, and it made the commute feel more enjoyable than usual.

Music-wise, I was really into "No Love" by Darknet and Enkojin. It had the right kind of hazy, heavy mood and stuck with me for a while.

I also started thinking more seriously about a personal challenge for next month: picking one part of myself that needs improvement and spending the next few months working on it. First focus is being more outgoing, which means going to more raves, concerts, and events solo, even when it feels uncomfortable. I want to build experiences that future me will be glad I actually showed up for.

The gym was a highlight too. I had a pretty solid session, set a lot of personal records, and felt noticeably stronger. It feels like eating more food is starting to pay off, and the extra calories are actually turning into better performance.

Overall, today felt busy but meaningful. Good commute, strong gym session, a song that matched the mood, and some clearer thoughts about the kind of person I want to become.

Sometimes life stacks a lot at once, but I’m grateful to wonderful co-workers and the usuals at the gym. They keep my day going when life takes a turn. ♥

title: Still Shaved
body: A couple months later, shaving my head might honestly have been one of the best decisions of my life. I feel a lot more confident now, and the burden of needing to worry about hair is just gone. It feels like a weight off my shoulders, basically. It has made life more enjoyable, the gym more enjoyable, swimming more enjoyable, traveling more enjoyable. To sound cringy, it was honestly kind of a pivotal moment in my life.

body: Met up with a distant friend, Gem, at Desert Breeze Park in Tempe. There was a pretty big furmeet and I met a lot of cool people. I'm glad I've gotten more outgoing over the years. His suit was really nice :3

body: Went to the zoo with family :3 It was a bit underwhelming, honestly. There were a couple of animals, but I didn't get to see the hyenas, which I really wanted to see. I did get to pet a goat though, which was the highlight of my day, because I love goats. Otherwise, yeah, very underwhelming for the price.
